irs.name: Seminar Room
irs.description: A real seminar room at Politecnico di Milano, measured with a linear microphone array. Medium size, natural.
irs.author: Federico Miotello, Paolo Ostan, Mirco Pezzoli, Luca Comanducci, Alberto Bernardini, Fabio Antonacci and Augusto Sarti (Politecnico di Milano)
irs.source: HOMULA-RIR (doi:10.5281/zenodo.10479726), source S1, linear-array microphones 0 and 33
irs.changes: Two array microphones combined into a stereo pair, the silence before the first arrival trimmed, the sides level-matched on their reverberation, the direct sound lowered by 9 dB, high-passed at 30 Hz, faded out, converted to FLAC.
